title: A clean Windows 11 host goes from no Python to a passing /kb-setup, on record
goal: kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md records one run on a clean Windows 11 host with Git for Windows and no Python: install-python.ps1's preflight and install output, the /kb-setup pass/fail report, and a final line result: pass; every failure found on the way is filed as a bug.

gates.question: Which clean Windows 11 host should the from-scratch /kb-setup run on?
options: Windows Sandbox on a Windows 11 Pro machine
gates.recommendation: Windows Sandbox on a Windows 11 Pro machine
gates.answer: Windows Sandbox on a Windows 11 Pro machine

notes: Windows Sandbox starts clean each time and is available on Windows 11 Pro with virtualization enabled (windows/windows-sandbox, DOC S-yexfxr4v); since 24H2 inbox Store apps are missing inside it, so the Store python3 alias is absent too. Claude Code must be installed inside the host for /kb-setup. The report uses placeholders (PL-LT-00123, jan.kowalski) for host and user names. 2026-09-29: out of SP-76inhw33 “Windows clone complete”; its task TK-hjqm7l7y was dropped when the operator chose not to run it in this sprint (to be tried on a live host later). A later sprint needs a new task.
